title: SchemeRegistration
description: A scheme entry in the agent's scheme registry. Defines what `<name>://` resolves to and how it's accessible.

name.description: Scheme name without `://`. Matches the URL scheme character class.

default_channel.description: Channel name selected when an op against this scheme has no fragment. Conventionally `body`; exec schemes typically declare `stdout`.

channel_previews.description: Per-channel preview policy for index tile rendering. Keys are channel names; values declare how much of each channel to surface in the index and from which end. Channels not listed here render under engine defaults (head, PLURNK_ENTRY_SIZE_DEFAULT_TOKENS). Streaming/temporal channels (SSE events, exec stdout, log tails) should declare `tail`; static-document channels (`body` of `known://`, `wiki://`) should declare `head`; small whole-content channels (`headers`, `symbols`) can declare `both`.

default_size_tokens.description: Tokens to render per side. When omitted, the engine uses PLURNK_ENTRY_SIZE_DEFAULT_TOKENS.
